crossRefs.note: Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve Yahweh…
Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all…
A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his…
Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab, I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight…
Saul sent messengers to David’s house, to watch him, and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him…
So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.
When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. Before the deadline,

translations.web: Saul said, I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Therefore Saul said to David, “You shall today be my son-in-law a second time.”
translations.bsb: “I will give her to David,” Saul thought, “so that she may be a snare to him, and the hand of the Philistines may be against him.” So Saul said to David, “For a second time now you can be my son-in-law.”
translations.kjv: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.
